slice: Constrain every retained workflow pagination URL to the exact GitHub repository Actions endpoint and immutable exact-commit query before it can enter chain reconciliation.
finding: Link-chain equality proves continuity between retained pages but does not independently establish that the chain remains on GitHub's API origin, targets the intended repository Actions endpoint, or preserves the exact-commit and exhaustive-enumeration query. URL trust must be validated separately and fail closed.
design_implication: Both authenticated enumeration clients should validate the initial request URL and every rel=next target with validateGitHubWorkflowPaginationUrl before issuing the request or accepting retained evidence. Only HTTPS api.github.com URLs for /repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/runs with one matching head_sha, per_page=100, optional positive page, and no narrowing filters are trusted.
falsification_route: A cross-origin or non-HTTPS URL is accepted.
A URL for another repository or endpoint is accepted.
A missing, changed, or duplicated head_sha is accepted.
A narrowing event/status/branch-style filter is accepted.
userinfo, fragments, invalid page numbers, or per_page below 100 are accepted.
uncertainty: The policy is not yet wired into the live enumerator or sanitized pagination-chain validator.
Authenticated private-repository enumeration was not executed in this slice.
GitHub Enterprise Server origins are intentionally unsupported by this repository-specific policy.
next_action: Wire this URL policy before every network fetch in both exhaustive clients and before retained-page reconciliation, then run both clients against one exact commit and retain raw outputs plus the reconciliation bundle.
